summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the SPARQL plugin. Changes: rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds the Update class (prologue, algebra); algebra.py translateUpdate always returns an Update, building the prologue from q.prologue[0] on the empty path; update.py evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; processor.py adds prepareUpdate (records _original_args) and leaves processUpdate and the string path unchanged; __init__.py exports prepareUpdate; test/test_sparql_prepare.py added with tests for each required behavior, including a no-mutation check. Nothing was run: tests, black, and the existing DAWG and prepareQuery suites are unverified. Nothing was committed.
